implementation_constraints: Pure Python stdlib only (json, re, shlex, sys)
reads one JSON object from stdin; verdict via exit code (0 allow, 2 block)
fail-closed everywhere; marker matched case-insensitive substring

unresolved_intent.rationale: spec names the read-only family by category, not exact identifiers; mapped to conventional host tool names, everything else conservative

unresolved_intent.decision: read-only iff no '>' redirection, no command substitution, and every stage verb in a READ_ONLY_VERBS allowlist; interpreters (python,node,ruby,perl), tee, cp/mv/rm and unknown verbs are writes
unresolved_intent.rationale: default-deny: treat as WRITE unless every part is a recognised reader; interpreters are opaque and not provable read-only

unresolved_intent.decision: write flags detected per-verb (sed -i, sort -o); a bare -o on grep is NOT a write
unresolved_intent.rationale: flag semantics are tool-specific; scoping avoids over-blocking legitimate golden reads

unresolved_intent.decision: missing tool_input coerced to empty object (allow if no golden); only non-dict payload or non-string tool_name blocks on shape
unresolved_intent.rationale: absent arguments carry no golden to protect; blocking would be over-strict without adding safety
